scripts.postinstall: sh -c 'if [ -d "task-manager/frontend" ]; then cd task-manager/frontend && npm install; else echo "no frontend to install"; fi'
scripts.build: sh -c 'if [ -d "task-manager/frontend" ]; then cd task-manager/frontend && npm run build; else echo "no frontend to build"; fi'
scripts.start: sh -c 'if [ -d "task-manager/frontend" ]; then cd task-manager/frontend && npm run dev; else echo "no frontend to start"; fi'
